title: Debate Scope Sparks Clash: Andrew Wilson presses Candace Owens on her claims; X spat intensifies
summary_full: Candace Owens and Andrew Wilson have clashed publicly over the terms of their planned debate. Owens said the discussion should focus on the Tyler Robinson case and rejected a proposed cross-examination format. Wilson responded that the debate should also examine Owens' own claims about the case and Kirk's assassination. The exchange went viral after critics accused Owens of avoiding scrutiny, fueling widespread online discussion before the debate even begins.
